description: This file defines the ScheduleRepository class with methods for managing schedule data, including fetching schedules, checking permissions, and setting defaults, using Prisma ORM.

classes.name: ScheduleRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling schedule data operations, including retrieval, permission checks, and default schedule management.

methods.name: findScheduleByIdForBuildDateRanges
methods.description: Fetches schedule with availability and user travel schedules by schedule ID.

methods.name: findScheduleByIdForOwnershipCheck
methods.description: Checks if a schedule exists and retrieves its user ID for ownership verification.

methods.name: findScheduleById
methods.description: Retrieves basic schedule details by schedule ID.

methods.name: findDetailedScheduleById
methods.description: Fetches detailed schedule info with permission checks, including working hours and overrides.

methods.name: findManyDetailedScheduleByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves multiple schedules for a user with detailed info and permission validation.

methods.name: getDefaultScheduleId
methods.description: Gets or sets the default schedule ID for a user.

methods.name: hasDefaultSchedule
methods.description: Checks if a user has a default schedule.

methods.name: setupDefaultSchedule
methods.description: Sets a default schedule for a user.
